## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:cli` · `area:api`, into `pm:queue`. `bootStack` composes the `MetadataPlugin` `os serve` composes, as its own rule says

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-12T19:53Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p2:** `@objectstack/verify` publishes a docblock (#22301 ruling A) saying `bootStack` composes what `os serve` composes, with two named exceptions. A stack's declared `apis` answer 404 under `bootStack` and 200 under `os serve`. So every test or dogfood that boots through the harness misses the declared-endpoint path, and since PR #23078 it logs a warning on every boot.
- **Direction:**
  - `bootStack` composes a `MetadataPlugin` the way `os serve` does: the same artifact-less composition PR #23078 gave a host config. ⛔ Not a test-only stub matcher.
  - The docblock's exception list stays the two it names.
  - Pin: `bootStack` of the showcase answers `GET /api/v1/apps/showcase/tasks` with 401 without a session and 200 with one, and logs no matcher warning.
- **Serial:** #15953 slice 4 (dispatched) holds `harness.ts`'s `bootStack` docblock. This card sequences after it.
- Triage: lands in `packages/verify/src/harness.ts` (`domain:cli`); rationale: the harness keeps its published rule.

Claim: PM loop round 7 · 2026-10-12T23:48Z
Session: `session_01VoSxBQujKLZKPwK2u5ehQ6`
Account: `os-steve` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; always the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-23088-bootstack-metadata-plugin`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-23088`
Domain: `domain:cli`
Seat: `domain:cli#2` (seat post #22648)
File surface (read on `origin/main` `965a1bfc72`; stop on a breach and explain it in the report):
- `packages/verify/src/harness.ts`, `bootStack`'s composition only. It composes the artifact-less `MetadataPlugin` that `os serve` gives a host config (PR #23078's `hostConfigMetadataDoor` shape: no artifact, `bootstrap: 'lazy'`, `rootDir` anchored to `hostRoot`, `watch: false`). A caller's own instance in `extraPlugins` takes its place by identity, as the rule already says for every other entry.
  - The docblock's exception list stays the two it names (triage `6131551384`). A docblock sentence changes only where the composition list must name the plugin.
  - ⛔ No second matcher, and ⛔ no test-only stub.
- `packages/verify/package.json`: the `@objectstack/metadata` dependency, if the import needs it. `pnpm-lock.yaml` is regenerated by `pnpm install`, never edited by hand.
- Tests: one new test under `packages/verify/src/` (or `packages/verify/test/`, as the package lays them out).
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/showcase-declarative-endpoints.dogfood.test.ts`: its header (about `:91`-`:96`) says the harness composes no `MetadataPlugin`, and that sentence is corrected. Whether its artifact-backed plugin stays (it proves the artifact ingestion path, and it takes the composed one's place by identity) is the dev's call, stated with its reason.
- One `.changeset/23088-*.md` (`@objectstack/verify` `patch`), carrying `Clause-②: no`.
- ⛔ Not touched: `packages/cli` (`serve.ts` is the reference, read only), `packages/metadata`, `packages/runtime`, and `harness.ts` outside `bootStack`'s composition and the one docblock sentence.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier` (`dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: "no path-derived mandate"). Ceiling `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, reason: the `metadata` slot's occupant changes on every `bootStack` boot, so what every verify proof and every app test boots moves (`/meta`, the registrars that read the metadata service, persistence, boot time). One contract-review-tier review is owed before the queue, judged from the card's content, as PR #23078 owed one. `check-governed-merges --test` over the claimed paths: not governed.
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `packages/verify harness.ts (this lane), bootStack composes no MetadataPlugin, so its metadata slot is the kernel's in-memory fallback with no matchEndpoint | the published bootStack docblock (#22301 ruling A) promises what os serve composes, and PR #23078 (7f2f081e8a) gave a host-config os serve boot the artifact-less MetadataPlugin | every declared apis endpoint answers 404 ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND under bootStack and 200 under os serve (showcase GET /api/v1/apps/showcase/tasks, measured on 62ce45d140), and every bootStack of a stack declaring apis logs B's no-matcher warning`
Thread-read: 6131551384
Serial constraints cleared:
- #15953 slice 4 (PR #23091, the `bootStack` docblock in `harness.ts`) landed at `965a1bfc72`, as triage's sequence requires.
- Of the 13 open PRs (file lists read in this act), one touches this surface: PR #22993 (#22870, draft, another lane) adds `@objectstack/service-mailbox` to `packages/verify/package.json` and so moves `pnpm-lock.yaml`. Its `package.json` hunk sits among the `service-*` entries, a different hunk from `@objectstack/metadata`'s. `pnpm-lock.yaml` has no merge driver, so whichever PR lands second regenerates it with `pnpm install` on its merge of `main`, never by hand. No open PR touches `harness.ts` or the dogfood test.
- This seat's other in-flight work is disjoint: #23050 slice 1 (`packages/rest`) and #23090 (PR #23106, in the merge queue; `packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts`, read only here).
